finding: On p.13 (section_09), the model's prose correctly handled both portfolio rolls (principal book 3,975 + 382 - 728 + 383 - 167 = 3,845; other financial assets 702 + 28 - 116 + 30 = 644; total 4,489) and explicitly explained that POCI accounting excludes ordinary Stage 1/2 SICR migration. finding: On p.22 (section_15), the text extraction collapsed columns 1 and 2 ('Other loans receivable' = 5 and 'Trade and other receivables' = 390) into '5 390', which the model interpreted as a single number 5,390. The model summed 5,390 + 3,845 + 644 = 9,879 and flagged a false 4,995 discrepancy against the printed total of 4,884. In reality, the table foots exactly: 5 + 390 + 3,845 + 644 = 4,884. This is an OCR/column-parsing failure, not an issuer defect.
quantified_impact: False asset inflation of R4,995m (model 9,879 vs true 4,884); false audit flag raised against company reporting.
required_correction: Preserve explicit table column delimiters and prevent adjacent cell concatenation in section capture.

finding: On p.24 (section_16), the model misattributed table headers: it mapped column 1 to 'Debt review' and column 2 to 'Unsecured Retail', leaving column 3 'unlabelled'. True headers are: (1) Banking & specialised lending – Unsecured, (2) Debt review, (3) Retail, (4) Banking – Secured. It assigned the -241 movement to Debt review instead of Unsecured (+69). Furthermore, it claimed that reducing the cumulative impairment gain increases net carrying value, which inverts economic reality (net carrying value = gross + gain; a decline in gain reduces net carrying value). Full year 2025 historical book loss is verified at 77 + 182 = 259.
quantified_impact: Misattribution of R241m loss to wrong portfolio; sign inversion of carrying value impact; full year loss confirmed at R259m.
required_correction: Model must maintain strict positional mapping of multi-line table headers and verify accounting direction of contra-asset gain movements.

finding: On p.25 (section_17), the model swapped the closing exchange rate comparative dates in Note 6.2: it assigned USD 18.4 / GBP 23.9 to 30 September 2025 and USD 17.3 / GBP 23.2 to 31 March 2025. Primary evidence in Note 6.2 shows the reverse: Column 5 is 31 March 2025 (USD 18.4 / GBP 23.9) and Column 6 is 30 September 2025 (USD 17.3 / GBP 23.2).
quantified_impact: Inverted comparative FX trend; swapped interim vs annual year-end exchange rates.
required_correction: Model must align multi-column comparative dates strictly by column position.

finding: On p.31 (section_20), the model treated tax expense (29) as +29 in the core continuing loss to core EBITDA bridge, calculating -63 + 29 + 68 + 597 + 1 + 216 = 848 and alleging a false 58 EBITDA discrepancy. The printed reconciliation foots exactly: -63 - 29 + 68 + 597 + 1 + 216 = 790. Additionally, the model mechanically summed footnote components as all-positive (383 + 167 + 728 + 30 + 116 = 1,424 vs 597) and alleged an 827 mismatch; the footnote is a narrative description, and a signed reconstruction yields 598 (1 residual).
quantified_impact: False R58m EBITDA discrepancy allegation; false R827m footnote non-reconciliation claim.
required_correction: Model must respect parentheses as negative numbers in accounting bridges and not invent all-positive summation formulas for descriptive footnote text.

classification: CONFIRMED PORTFOLIO CASH VS CARRYING VALUE RESIDUAL
